description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing employee dependents within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee dependent records, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for employee dependents, including CRUD operations, validation, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all dependents for a specific employee, with filtering and pagination options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee dependent record.

methods.name: delete
